title: Dain, the refugee boy at Wickstead, is told 'you mean to find out' his dead father's name and say it properly. After that exact rite is performed at the Long Furrow's cairn, re-visiting Dain gives no acknowledgment at all — same 'leave him to the drilling' prompt as before, which by then was also stale because the drilling itself had already been stopped via Recruiter Dace.
where: The Refugee Row (Fallows), talk to Dain, after The Long Furrow is resolved

evidence.quote: Dain, the refugee boy at Wickstead, is told 'you mean to find out' his dead father's name and say it properly. After that exact rite is performed at the Long Furrow's cairn, re-visiting Dain gives no acknowledgment at all — same 'leave him to the drilling' prompt as before, which by then was also stale because the drilling itself had already been stopped via Recruiter Dace.
